items: His clip says "Every teenager in the country taken", holds, then "round a prison" with his lips closing on the p. Every earlier take said "taken round a prison" in one quick run, so it started late and hit the p early.

Re-voiced in his locked voice, words unchanged, with a pause after "taken" (20 takes); the one whose timing matches his mouth (R4-10) is in: he opens on "Every", both pause together, and "round a prison" lands on his mouth.
Everything else as rough cut 6 (37.3 s).
A release title of our own.

replies.at241: Fixed in rough cut 7: the pitch re-voiced to his clip's own rhythm (a pause after "taken", then "round a prison" on his mouth). Checked frame by frame on the cut.
